🫏 New post ready 📚 List · being kind to yourself · 8 slides “the quiet ways you started looking after yourself” 📝 Slides
1. the quiet ways you started looking after yourself 2. shutting the laptop screen while afternoon light is still on the desk, even with three unread tabs waiting. 3. rinsing your face with cold water over the basin, then pulling on a thick pair of dry socks. 4. packing tomorrow's lunch into a tin before bed, so the morning feels like someone already looked out for you. 5. taking the longer route past the library, just to buy seven quiet minutes before you unlock the door. 6. filling a glass right to the brim and sitting on the rug to drink it, instead of gulping it down by the tap. 7. saying "i am tired" out loud in the empty hall, without listing three reasons why you shouldn't be. 8. save this for an evening you forget that you are someone worth looking after.
✍️ Caption
we are patient with everybody else until our own turn comes. looking after yourself is rarely an event. most days it is just turning the big light off and letting today be done. save this for an evening when the week ahead already feels heavy. #selflovequotes #bekindtoyourself #rest
